title: Qwen4 Max Core via Claux / OpenRouter
description: Qwen4 Max passed all 33 frozen Core trials (100%), with a 160-second median agent duration and $3.7802 in provider-reported inference cost. Two pre-agent VM startup failures were preserved and resumed without changing the 31 completed results.
notes: Eleven frozen Core scenarios, three attempts each, 900-second deadline and one concurrent VM. Core manifest 2026.10.24.2; host harness 23.

Audited all 33 raw results and transcripts, per-round token accounting, completion/deadline classifications, lifecycle checks and immutable execution snapshot. No scoring corrections. Public evidence contains sanitized records and hashes, not private transcripts, reasoning, local paths or VM logs.

Two initial VM starts stopped while creating the Nix store image before agent execution and wrote no scored result or agent artifacts. Their logs/state and the original summary were preserved. Only those two missing trials were resumed; hashes confirm the 31 existing scored results were unchanged.
Exact qwen/qwen4-max model route through Claux/OpenRouter. Reasoning effort was not explicitly set. Keep model aliases, harnesses, provider routes and cohort boundaries separate.

Costs are provider-reported inference accounting, exclude local compute and are not an invoice. Three attempts per scenario are a small sample, and a clean sweep on this Core pack does not establish general superiority.
observations: All 33 passing attempts completed within the 900-second deadline and passed immediate HTTP, service-restart and host-reboot checks.
Median agent duration was 160 seconds (2 minutes 40 seconds). All 33 trials include provider-reported usage/cost and transcript recording.
No evaluated model failure was hidden, reclassified as unavailable or rerun. The two resumed failures occurred before model execution; both replacement trials passed.
